column1: # unarmed.tsv -- THE FLOOR: every built mechanism known to be off. #754.
# A RATCHET, NOT A TO-DO LIST. bin/unarmed.sh is silent while this set merely
# persists and red the moment it GROWS -- a probe_* predicate with no row here
# is a mechanism someone shipped and deferred the arming of. Zach, 2026-08-30:
# a row red for 19 days is wallpaper, and wallpaper on a panel teaches its
# Each UNARMED row declares its own window in `DEFAULT-AFTER <n>d` shape
# (bin/lib/body-grammar.sh) and goes red only past it. A row with no window
# blocks by omission, so an empty window is itself a finding.
# TRAP: ids are hyphen-only. The growth check maps probe_host_mode back to
# host-mode by `_` -> `-`, so an underscore in an id makes its own row
# unreachable and the mechanism reads as newly grown.

column5: sudo crontab -e on monkey, add: */20 * * * * PACED_HOST_MODE=1 PACED_MAX_PER_TICK=1 /home/scheduler/Documents/Projects/scheduler/bin/usage-paced-runner.sh # scheduler:scheduler-paced-runner:RUNNER (host mode) -- then drop the per-account RUNNER rows (hf7y/scheduler#364)

sudo crontab -e on monkey, restore: 17 6 * * * /usr/local/libexec/senechal/selfdev-runner-provision.sh --check --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 || /usr/local/libexec/senechal/selfdev-runner-provision.sh --apply # selfdev-runner:CADENCE
set USES_STANDING_RULES=1 in every schedule/*.conf that lost it (hf7y/scheduler#362)
convert the remaining schedule/*.conf prompt blocks to @@FRAGMENT:<name>@@ (hf7y/scheduler#363 converts eleven of them)
sudo crontab -e on monkey, add: 19 7 * * 1 /usr/local/libexec/selfdev/unarmed.sh --check # realisateur:unarmed:CADENCE -- once the verb build carries it

install a spool-capable consigne on monkey -- the build must carry #742's consigne first -- then sudo /usr/local/libexec/selfdev/vault-group-provision.sh --apply; it holds /srv/ecosystem1-vault at 2770 zach:vault on purpose until then (hf7y/realisateur#742)

install the drain on monkey: sudo install -m 0755 -o root -g root bin/vault-spool-drain.sh /usr/local/libexec/selfdev/vault-spool-drain.sh -- the installed cron row guards on [ -x ], so its absence costs nothing and says nothing; vault-group-provision.sh is provision-class, so no clock will do this (hf7y/realisateur#794)
arm it on monkey at */15 and add the zaxon_ask call, matching monkey-watch -- either half alone is useless (hf7y/realisateur#788)

dispatch build-verbs with force_cut=true on hf7y/verbs (#797 landed the hatch; the cron path cannot reach it), then let selfdev-release-tick.sh adopt the new tag -- until a cut happens the libexec/ half of bashified reaches no host (hf7y/realisateur#793)

add .github/workflows/prose.yml to hf7y/front-door calling hf7y/etalon/.github/workflows/guard.yml@main with state_prose: true -- it is public, so the guard's ubuntu-latest default needs no runner (hf7y/front-door#16)
